rationale: The original short thesis relied on a tight bear flag below VWAP, but since entry the 5-min action shows a large bullish engulfing candle that recovered most of the drop and reclaimed the 9-EMA. With invalidation only ~0.39% above the current price and short-term momentum shifting upward, the stop-out risk before the target has risen. Closing the short protects capital as the setup is no longer valid.
